title: Generic Web Scraper
oneLiner: URL-in, structured-data-out scraper that cleans HTML for reliable LLM inference.
objective: Build a generic web scraper that takes any URL, fetches and preprocesses HTML for LLM inference, and cleans the data for improved accuracy.
achievements: Used Pydantic models for strict, optimized data validation.
Enabled efficient extraction from web pages using Selenium Stealth.
Transformed raw pages into meaningful, structured data ready for OpenAI inference.
